item.name: San Diego Winery Tour
item.description:
#*Think that Napa was the first place to produce wines in California? Think again!*

##All participants drinking alcohol must be age 21 or over, with valid ID.
Guests drinking alcohol must be 21+. Guests 18-20 are permitted on our tours but may not be allowed into certain establishments. Guests 17 and younger must purchase a private tour.

##Duration
Tour - approximately 6 hours
Entire Experience - approximately 7 hours (this includes pick up/drop off)

##About
San Diego County is actually where wineries and viticulture (the science, production, and study of grapes) began in the Golden State! Let us do the driving and you do the drinking! This tour includes a visit to a local, family run vineyard with a knowledgeable and passionate guide to teach you about the process of winemaking, and a delicious winery dinner. You'll learn about the history of the winery and about San Diego's role in creating a booming California wine culture.

**Highlights of this VIP guided adventure include:**
•  Approx. 6 hour VIP guided adventure to stunning and unique local vineyards.
• Ample tasting and large pours of local wines.
• Entertaining commentary on local history, and viticulture.
• Door-to-door transportation (from most San Diego locations).
• Wine tasting appreciation presentation, and guided winery tour.
• Delicious Winery Meal
• Complete coordination by San Diego Beer, Wine & Spirits Tours.

Above adventure includes wine tastings, food, door-to-door transportation, entertainment, and San Diego Beer, Wine & Spirits expert guide.
item.booking_notes:
##You have booked the San Diego Winery Tour with meeting time between approx 9.30 and 10 AM.

We’re excited to take you on a chauffeured adventure to two winery estates. 

Your tour ticket includes all your tastings and food; it does not include tour guide gratuity, UNLESS you selected paid for while booking (industry standard is 20% which is $37 per person). Groups of 3 or more will be contacted for tour guide gratuity before the tour.

Food, wine, schedule, vehicle, tour size and wineries are subject to change.

## IMPORTANT:
- Before your tour, fill out and sign the waiver form, see "SIGN WAIVER" button above.
- Then, see "Copy Link" button on the waiver form to send to ALL in your party to fill out.
THANK YOU!

NOTE:
- We'll text you by 8.30AM morning of tour to confirm your pickup location and time. If you don't hear from us by 8.30AM, it means we are having trouble reaching you so please call our office at 858.551.5115
- Thank you for choosing your pick up meeting location (see "Booking Details"). 
- If you do NOT have a U.S. cell number, we will email you with your exact pick up time the morning of the tour. 
- PLEASE SHARE ALL the information in your text, with EACH GUEST IN YOUR PARTY. 

**Please note:** This is not a private tour (although in some instances your group may be the only group on the tour), unless you have specifically requested and paid for a private tour. Numbers can change last minute on our tours so please understand if your group is smaller or larger than you expected 

- Please be at your pick up location at the time YOUR TEXT MESSAGE states as your driver cannot wait. Tour tickets cannot be refunded and cannot be rescheduled because your space is being guaranteed at the event.**

##What to expect:
 
- Wear layers in order to be prepared for temperature changes. Bring hat/sun protection for sunny weather, and a jacket/sweater for cooler weather.
- Please plan ahead and bring some cash to tip your wonderful tour guide (unless prepaid at time of booking).
- We will be having a variety of food served from a set menu. We MAY be able to make substitutions on the menu, BUT you must prearrange that.*
- No food or drink to be consumed on the vehicle (except water). There will be plenty of food and drinks at the venues! We also provide bottled water.
- Bring your ID. Guests drinking alcohol must be 21+. Guests 18-20 are permitted on our tours but may not be allowed into certain establishments. Guests 17 and younger must purchase a private tour.
- Please don't wear perfumes or colognes as this can interfere with the subtle aromas of the wine.
-NO glitter clothing/accessories allowed (a cleaning fee will be charged for any glitter left on vehicle).
- We suggest you refrain from smoking for your entire tour as that can alter your tasting palate.
- Please bring umbrella if chance of rain.
- Only pre-booked and paid guests are allowed on the wine tour. No walk-ins or unarranged additions.

Consider purchasing wine at the wineries as that will be a delicious memory of your adventure. San Diego Beer, Wine & Spirits Tours loves to support our local wineries; we do not receive commissions from your purchases.

*San Diego Beer, Wine & Spirits Tours make reasonable efforts to communicate to the winery kitchens regarding guests' dietary requests and are not responsible for the ingredients used in the preparation of the food served at the wineries. Please monitor what you eat and drink. THANK YOU!
